question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Abscond
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abscond"** means to leave hurriedly and secretly, typically to avoid detection or arrest. (फरार होना)

 
 
• **Example: **The thief** absconded** with the stolen goods before the police arrived.
 
 
 
• **"Appear" **means to become visible or come into sight; it is the opposite of disappearing or absconding. (प्रकट होना)
 
 
• **Example: **The magician made the rabbit** appear** out of the hat.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the **opposite **of **'abscond' **is **'appear'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Clear Out **(साफ़ करना): To leave a place quickly.
 
• **Example:** The residents were told to clear out before the building was demolished.
 
• **Tarnish **(धूमिल करना): To lose or cause to lose luster, especially as a result of exposure to air or moisture.
 
 
• **Example: **The silverware began to tarnish after being left out for too long.
 
 
 
• **Guilty** (दोषी): Responsible for a specified wrongdoing.
 
 
• **Example:** The jury found the defendant guilty of all charges.
 
 

33:Tb85,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.</
